Messages.Author: Alexander Michels
Messages.Body:
I have a question about the use of Babble (which I'm pretty sure I know
anyway).

Can Babble (both normal and superior) be used to react to any action? (I'm
pretty sure you can - is there anything that says you cannot?)

Also, is it legal to untap (superior: "Tap to untap another ready minion.
Not usable by a blocking minion.") an acting minion (that you do NOT
control, i.e. during someone elses turn) as they are tapping to take that
action (Again, I assume this is okay too).

Lastly, the one I'm most confused on, is can a minion who failed to block
use Babble at superior to untap another minion after the block has failed?
He's no longer a blocking minion, but I've heard people argue for either
side of this problem.

Thanks,
Alexander Michels

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Alexander Michels wrote:
> I have a question about the use of Babble (which I'm pretty sure I know
> anyway).
>
> Can Babble (both normal and superior) be used to react to any action? (I'm
> pretty sure you can - is there anything that says you cannot?)

Any that is taken by another Methuselah's minion, yes.

> Also, is it legal to untap (superior: "Tap to untap another ready minion.
> Not usable by a blocking minion.") an acting minion (that you do NOT
> control, i.e. during someone elses turn) as they are tapping to take that
> action (Again, I assume this is okay too).

Sure.

> Lastly, the one I'm most confused on, is can a minion who failed to block
> use Babble at superior to untap another minion after the block has failed?

Yes.

> He's no longer a blocking minion, but I've heard people argue for either
> side of this problem.

> Thanks,
> Alexander Michels
